v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: All resource capacities must be non-negative
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: All requested capacities must be non-negative
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: Each request must be a dictionary
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_5: There should always be at least 1 free resource
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: Requests should not exceed available resources

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: The system shall accept a mapping of resource to their total available capacity
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: The system shall accept a list of resources
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: The system shall reject any request that is not a dictionary mapping resources to requested capacities
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: The system shall reject any request that references a resource that is not available
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_5: The system shall reject negative resource capacities
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_6: The system shall determine an allocation is feasible iff the requested quantity is less than the available capacity
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_7: The system shall reject any allocation that fully exhausts the available resources

v2_human_g3_goal: The system should check if a request as feasible based on available resources. There should always be at least 1 free resource
v2_human_g3_input: resources: a dictionary type where each resource name is the key and the value is available (capacity)

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: A request that exhausts all resources should not be deemed feasible
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: All resources should not be allocated at the same time

v2_human_g3_output: True or false if the resource allocation is feasible or not

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: Should always be at least 1 free resource
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: Request only from resources that exist
